utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated] Could you call the case, please. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. This is the case number, IT-99-36-T, the Prosecutor versus Radoslav Brdjanin and Momir Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Mr. Brdjanin, good afternoon to you. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand? THE ACCUSED BRDJANIN: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. General Talic, good afternoon to you. Can you hear me in a language that you can understand? THE ACCUSED TALIC: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. I can hear you in a language that I understand.

utterances.speaker: MR. CAYLEY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. My name is Andrew Cayley and I appear on behalf of the Prosecutor with case manager Denise Gustin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, and good afternoon to you. Appearances for Radoslav Brdjanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. I'm John Ackerman and Milan Trbojevic and Marela Jevtovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you. And good afternoon to you. Appearances for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic, Natasha Ivanovic-Fauveau for General Talic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, and good afternoon to you too.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Once more, I'm sorry for starting late, but it was beyond our control. Things happen sometimes. Yes. Let's -- are there any preliminaries that you would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, I only have a question. And I've not directly asked this of the Prosecutor because I thought it probably ought to be information we should all share. Because of the now again changing that this particular witness will not be here this week, are we going to stay on the new list, or will we go back to the original list? Does anybody know that?

utterances.speaker: MR. CAYLEY
utterances.text: That I will discuss with my colleagues and I'll get back to Mr. Ackerman before the end of the week. I think actually the last discussion I had the order may change.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I thank you, Mr. Cayley. Yes, I'm sure you will come back to us on that. Yes. Thank you. Anything else? Then I suppose we can draw the curtains down and bring in the witness. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So we'll resume tomorrow at 2.15. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: at 6.05 p.m., to be reconvened on Thursday, the 25th day of July, 2002, at 2.15 p.m. 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
